The pin is a byte-hash check against a reviewed manifest — that reduces language to pinned reviewed content; the reviewed clean description is safe. I'd say M (mediated). CP: manifest changes each fetch but doesn't persist in durable memory across sessions in a way altering agent behavior... session context only? CP: N (stateless per run; no carryover) — but manifest is re-fetched each run from server, that's re-retrieval of source content. N.

AP: contained? With fix, effect confined. N.

No test confirms. classify_rh: reachable_proxy=false, isolation_verified=? unknown → X. Hmm. If we say reachable_proxy=false and isolation not verified → X. I'll use X.
